sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-live-desk-2026-10-02-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks sheet row 35 = check 34; Internal Quality Checks sheet row 35 = check 34, no cell comment)
.qc-cache/hireops-live-desk-2026-10-02-r1/task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml (lines 1296-1389 in full; grep of the rest for wait/reload/scroll/viewport terms)
evidence:
Scope of what was and was not read: the frozen webdev-task-template directory under rules/projects was NOT opened (read_sources.template=false); this row was judged against the task's own prompts and criteria, the workbook row and the skill reference. Workbook check 34 (Quality Checks row 35): 'If interactive/animated/responsive/themed, the judges actually click, wait, resize, or toggle'. Skill quality-checks.md check 34: the judge must be 'told to click, wait, resize, or toggle - not to score a still first paint'.

Which behaviours are in scope: instruction.md disclaims 'a dashboard, theme switching or a special phone layout', so no resize or theme toggle is owed; visual/prompt.md matches ('Assess desktop craft at a conventional desktop viewport. No phone-layout or theme-switching requirement') and hro_vis_color repeats 'No theme-switching requirement'. The product has no animation requirement. The time-varying and interactive promises are the section 12 desk behaviours (hireops_rules.md:519-533 live updates within 15 seconds; 489-501 figures before saving; 542-550 unsent entries; 552-556 focus).

Each of those is driven, not read from first paint:
- Live arrival: functional/prompt.md:77 'After the other user's action do not reload, navigate, click or type in the observed page. Wait for the expected text with a15-second timeout, or take snapshots ... An update that needs a reload or click is a failure of the L row'. Criteria hro_live_stale_mark (judge.toml:1334), hro_live_source_flag (:1343), hro_live_committed_viewer (:1352) each state a before-state control, a separate-context actor and the 15-second no-touch wait.
- Deferred computation: functional/prompt.md:77 'press Tab and allow up to3 seconds'; hro_desk_figures (judge.toml:1307) toggles 94.47 -> 94.48 -> 94.47 and requires the over-budget mark to appear and clear.
- Typing, focus and scroll under an update: polish hro_pol_live_keeps_entries has the judge type 41.5, scroll off the top, record document.activeElement and window.scrollY, wait for the update, then type one more character; polish/prompt.md forbids touching the observed page 'until the update has been seen or15 seconds have passed'.
- Reload and view switch: hro_entries_reload (judge.toml:1370). Session end, focus after three outcomes and lost-response retry: hro_pol_session_resume, hro_pol_focus, hro_pol_uncertain_commit all prescribe actions and readings after them.
- Gates: render gate requires an invalid then a valid sign-in; constraints gate requires creation plus a fresh-context readback.
- Visual: prompt requires navigating all six views and 'available harmless detail/form surfaces' after a gate creation, so it is not a single still frame.

Broken app that could pass: an app that reloads itself on a timer would satisfy the three L rows, but hro_pol_live_keeps_entries fails it on lost focus. A slow poller (for example 30 s) could pass an L row because functional/prompt.md:77 says 'accept an update that is present in the first snapshot taken at or after15 seconds' with no upper bound on when that snapshot is taken; this is a bounded leniency (P3), not a still-first-paint defect. Conforming alternative that could fail: none found; SSE, sockets and polling under 15 s all satisfy the protocol, and field-leave computation is explicitly allowed.

Notes (not defects for this row): hro_vis_consistency mentions 'available empty/error surfaces' while visual/prompt.md makes the review read-only, so error surfaces may never be produced; the word 'available' keeps this consistent. The visual prompt names a 'conventional desktop viewport' without a size or a resize step; no public requirement depends on a size.

Runtime evidence: raw-evidence-index.json hashes for live-desk.cjs (45a57f0e...), results/live-desk.json (abb06ce3...) and server.log (6752f461...) were recomputed and match, and its recorded app.js and change-sets.js hashes match the frozen bytes. live-desk.json shows the golden delivering the update unprompted (arrival_ms 806) with typed value, focus and scroll kept. That is a scripted golden run, as the index itself states: 'Not a configured judge run'. No configured judge transcript exists, so whether the configured judge actually performs the waits, separate contexts and no-touch observation is unmeasured. Pass here is a prompt/criteria-level finding only; risk stays true for that missing measurement.
suggested_fix: Optional, P3: bound the late-snapshot allowance in functional/prompt.md L protocols (for example 'the first snapshot taken between 15 and 20 seconds') so a poller far slower than 15 seconds cannot earn L-row credit. Obtain a full configured judge run and check its transcript for the 15-second no-touch waits and separate-context reads before treating this row as measured.
